lines.t: Verse 1
YahuShua, Beloved of my soul,
You called me beyond the noise of this world,
Beyond the striving, beyond the fear,
Into this secret place Your hands prepared.
Chorus
And there I find You, waiting for me,
In the hidden place only love can see.
Joy like a river, joy like the sea,
Pouring from Your heart into the depths of me.
YahuShua, YahuShua,
Fairest of ten thousand and more;
You fill every chamber You formed with Your hands,
And I am Yours forevermore.
Verse 2
Before I drew breath, You fashioned a place,
Deep in the mystery of Your grace;
A doorway concealed from the wisdom of men,
Yet opened by love and faith again.
Chorus
And there I find You, waiting for me,
In the hidden place only love can see.
Joy like a river, joy like the sea,
Pouring from Your heart into the depths of me.
YahuShua, YahuShua,
Fairest of ten thousand and more;
You fill every chamber You formed with Your hands,
And I am Yours forevermore.
Bridge
From grace to Grace, You carry me,
From light to The Light eternally.
A flame from Your glory alive in clay,
No darkness remains where You make Your stay.
No wind can quench it, no night conceal it,
No power of earth or shee-ohl can steal it.
The fire You shared from Your own heart's blaze
Cause me to praise forever the Ancient of Days.
Final Chorus
There I will stay, hidden in Thee,
In the secret place You prepared for me.
Joy without measure, peace without end,
Held by my Savior, my Brother, my Friend.
YahuShua, YahuShua,
King of Glory, Ancient of Days;
The flame You placed within my spirit
Will answer forever with praise.
Outro
Beloved, come...
Drink from the river.
Rest in the light.
Abide in the love
That conquered the night.
YahuShua...
YahuShua...
YahuShua...
